description: Map security findings to compliance controls (SOC2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO27001, EUAIACT). Scans a directory and groups issues by control. Output includes a summary section at the top; for large projects, findings are truncated to top 50. Use mode=executive for C-level summary. Example: compliance_report({path: '.', framework: 'SOC2'})

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

mode.description: Report mode: full (detailed) or executive (C-level summary)

name: compliance_report
